statement:
noncomputable def x2611_10667_p (B C : ℕ) (t : ℚ) : Polynomial ℚ :=
  (-Polynomial.X) ^ B * Finset.sum (Finset.range (C + 2)) (fun i =>
    Polynomial.C ((1 - t) ^ ((C : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) *
      (-t) ^ ((i : ℤ) - 1) *
      ((if i = 0 then 0 else (Nat.choose C (i - 1) : ℚ)) -
        t * (Nat.choose (C + 1) i : ℚ))) * Polynomial.X ^ i)
